title: draba alpina var. glacialis
intro: Draba alpina var. glacialis, commonly known as Alpine Whitlow Grass, is a rare and unique plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of inflammation, infections, and respiratory issues, due to its antiseptic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Whitlow Grass include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and protect against bacterial and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional herbal medicine.
